scientific_decisions.source_name: Bulk-merging every historical E. crus-galli variety or subspecies into modern E. crus-galli
scientific_decisions.reason: Several historical infraspecific names map to separately accepted E. muricata, E. walteri, E. oryzoides, or E. oryzicola. FAIL is for the proposed merge rule, not a species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual photographs/source observations in canonical E. crus-galli learner
scientific_decisions.reason: The card itself notes that E. muricata shares absent ligule and overlapping panicles; taxonomic acceptance and photographer labels do not independently confirm modern species ID. Keep original photos, attribution, and provisional status untouched.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry of individual Echinochloa observations
scientific_decisions.reason: No examined specimen/genetic or hybrid-specific morphological evidence establishes hybrid ancestry. No hybrid parent assignment, parentage claim or removal of existing HOLD.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hoste & Verloove (2022) E. crus-galli var. oryzoides vs POWO accepted E. oryzoides
scientific_decisions.reason: 2022 revision uses E. crus-galli var. oryzoides within a broad E. crus-galli concept, while POWO/WCVP currently synonymizes that name to separately accepted E. oryzoides. Preserve both source concepts; historical records require original diagnostic evidence.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Older un-authored E. crus-galli sensu lato / barnyardgrass records
scientific_decisions.reason: Older labels may include several now accepted species; neither the bare vernacular name nor missing-rank infraspecific epithets justify automatic reassignment. Escalate records with missing author, rank, or diagnostic specimen.
